rationale: Power intent is per-implementation, not protocol-level

extraction_strategy.ic_class_applicability_gate_v0_1_62: ic_class='bus_interconnect_protocol' declares LL21 not applicable; emitted as N/A stub (l_doc_taxonomy.na_stub)

low_power_modes_summary.axi_idle: Manager drives no valid xVALIDs; ACLK gating is implementation-defined.
low_power_modes_summary.ace_idle: No outstanding coherent or snoop traffic; snoop channels' VALIDs LOW; clock gating allowed.
low_power_modes_summary.ace_q_channel_intent: Q-Channel (separate AMBA Low Power Interface, ARM IHI 0068) is typically layered on top of ACE for power-down handshakes; that's outside IHI 0022E scope.

fields.notes: Power-domain partitioning, voltage-domain crossings, power-gate sequencing, isolation, retention, and Q-Channel low-power handshakes are deferred to SoC integration (UPF/CPF) and other AMBA documents. ACE coherency requires powered-down masters to drop out of the shareability domain cleanly.
